title: Lixity — Private Manuscript Studio, Prose Rhythm & Dialogue Voices
description: Sense where chapters drag or flatten, separate character voices from the narrator, and spot abrupt scene shifts—100% offline, private, and with zero AI rewriting.
eyebrow: Your voice. Your research. Your craft.
headline:
A focused sanctuary for your manuscript.
Precision in rhythm, clarity in craft.
intro: Hear where a chapter breathes or stalls. Dim the narration to isolate dialogue and hear if your characters sound alike. Trace every scene detail and historical fact back to its source, and share clean reading copies—all inside a private, offline studio built for authors.
demo_note: Fictional English manuscript. Interactive read-only demo. No account or upload required.
preview: The real workspace: read your prose undisturbed, then reveal rhythm, dialogue, and scene patterns whenever you choose.
tasks_title: From first draft to finished scene.
read_text: Read in clean typography, drop review markers where a line catches, and check sentence cadence in context. The built-in editor pairs calm drafting with automatic local saves, conflict protection, and full undo history—so drafting and revision stay in one place.
research_text: Link manuscript passages straight to primary sources, character dossiers, and story decisions. Saved snapshots preserve the evidence behind every detail—keeping historical facts, places, and motives consistent across drafts.
share_title: Clean reading copies and print proofs.
share_text: Create crisp book PDFs, standalone offline companion sites, or focused proof copies for beta readers and editors. No cloud accounts, no lock-in: your manuscript stays completely yours.
principle: Insight without interference: the author leads.
principle_text: Lixity holds up a clear mirror to your prose, never a rulebook. It never grades your writing or rewrites a single line with AI. You see the exact words behind every pattern and decide what belongs in your voice.
start_text: Install Lixity locally on Windows, macOS, or Linux. Open any Markdown or plain-text draft by following the setup guide.
scope: Install v0.8.0 locally in seconds. Optional speech and research tools stay strictly separate and under your control.
languages_text: Read this site in seven languages. The app adapts to the language of your manuscript; technical documentation remains in English.
limits: Language rules and coverage vary by language, with German and English offering the deepest checks. Switching the interface language never alters your manuscript.
feedback_text: Tell us what you were writing, checking, or sharing, and where the studio helped or got in your way. You never need to send your manuscript.
linguistics_title: Hear the pulse and voices of your prose.
linguistics_text: Catch glue-heavy sentences that slow pacing, test whether characters speak differently from the narrator, and spot indirect speech, repeated words, or abrupt POV and scene shifts. Every signal highlights the exact words on the page—100% offline, with optional genre ranges and zero AI rewriting.
language_suggestion: Prefer another language? Use your saved choice or a language supported by your browser.
tour_title: Lixity in 42 seconds: editor, rhythm, dialogue & research
tour_note: Silent recording · Light & dark themes · Classic novels (Effi Briest, Pride & Prejudice) + Warehouse 4
tour_read: Tested on classics: sticky sentences in Effi Briest & character voice contrast in Pride & Prejudice.
tour_passage: Press D for Direct Speech Mode: dim narration, isolate spoken lines, and hear your dialogue.
tour_compare: Write in the built-in editor, inspect revision deltas, and switch between sticky sentences, dialogue tags, and word echoes.
tour_research: Spot scene hooks, implicit scene breaks, and natural sentence rhythm across every chapter.
tour_context: Research beside your draft: dossiers, timelines, and every fact linked to its verified source.
tour_return: Return to calm, distraction-free prose—or test your own passage 100% offline in the Browser Sandbox.
tour_error: The video could not load. Explore the interactive demo instead.
editor_status: Ready in v0.8.0: full offline prose analysis, Direct Speech Mode, manuscript reader, research dossiers, and standalone reading copies—plus the built-in editor in the current release.
workflow: Close reading, research notes, and chapter comparisons stay anchored to your words. Everything runs privately on your computer; optional speech and research tools are set up separately.
compare_lead: Lixity does not replace a human editor or rewrite your prose. It complements cloud style checkers and scene planners wherever local privacy, deterministic signals, and source provenance matter.
compare_lix_privacy: 100% local & offline; your manuscript never leaves your machine, zero AI training
compare_lix_method: Deterministic prose signals (CV, IQR, entropy, dialogue & indirect speech) anchored to exact lines
compare_cld_method: Rule & AI suggestions, readability scores, optional rewrites
compare_pln_method: Story arc & scene-element checklists, minimal line-level linguistics
compare_lix_research: Integrated local source archive (PDF, image, audio) with cited passages & revision diffs
compare_pln_research: Character & plot notes without source-byte provenance
compare_lix_license: Open source (AGPL-3.0), free local app, 7 UI & analysis languages
